content.name: Priya Raman
content.title: Cyber Security Analyst
content.summary: Cyber security analyst with nine years in Canberra, moving from IT support into a managed SOC and now protecting a regional water utility's corporate and operational networks. Led the utility's Essential Eight uplift from Maturity Level One to Two across seven strategies. Holds a Baseline security clearance and GCIH.

experience.title: IT Support Officer
bullets: Supported 90 lawyers and staff, handling accounts, devices and the document management system.
Volunteered to own the firm's patching schedule, bringing monthly patch compliance from 60% to 97%.
Configured email filtering rules that blocked a run of invoice-fraud emails targeting the accounts team.

experience.title: SOC Analyst
bullets: Monitored and investigated alerts for 18 clients, including not-for-profits and two Commonwealth contractors.
Wrote Elastic detection rules for living-off-the-land techniques, adopted across all client tenants.
Prepared incident timelines for clients reporting to the ACSC, meeting their contractual deadlines in every case.
Mentored three junior analysts and led the weekly threat-intelligence round-up.

experience.title: Cyber Security Analyst
bullets: Monitor corporate IT and operational technology networks for a utility supplying 210,000 residents.
Led the Essential Eight uplift from Maturity Level One to Two in seven of eight strategies over 18 months.
Segmented SCADA networks from corporate IT with the OT team, removing 40 unnecessary cross-network firewall paths.
Run the vulnerability management programme, reducing critical findings older than 30 days from 120 to 9.

courses.name: GIAC Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional (GICSP)

achievements.title: Baseline security clearance (AGSVA)
achievements.detail: Held since 2020 for work with Commonwealth contractor clients.

achievements.title: Volunteer, school cyber safety talks
achievements.detail: Give online-safety sessions to Year 7 and 8 students at ACT schools each term.
